My Favourite

A letter (don't get emotional, ew) 💌

Happy Birthday, Tripti ❤️😭🫶🏻 I genuinely don't even know where to start, but I just want you to know how grateful I am to have you in my life. Thank you for being such a great friend to me for so long, for always listening to me, for being there when I need someone, and for putting up with me even when I'm being an absolute idiot. 😭 We've both made mistakes along the way, and I know there are things you've done that I've forgiven you for, just like there are things I've done for which I hope you'll forgive me too. At the end of the day, I don't want a few mistakes or bad moments to ever overshadow what our friendship means to me. Nobody's perfect, and I know I'm definitely not, but I'm genuinely thankful that we've had each other through everything. And of course, you're welcome for listening to your AWFUL, absolutely HORRENDOUS singing all this time. 😭😭 I deserve some kind of award for that, honestly. But jokes aside, I think that's one of the things I love about us. I can laugh at you, you can annoy the hell out of me, and somehow, you're still one of my favourite people. And yes, as much as your singing hurts my ears, I wouldn't really want it any other way. 😭❤️ I genuinely wish to see you happy, always. Like, genuinely happy. I hate the thought of you being sad or crying, and if life ever gets too much for you, I hope you know you don't have to deal with everything alone. You can always come to me, whether you want to rant, cry, talk about the most random nonsense ever, or just have someone sit and listen to you. You don't always have to be okay around me. No matter what happens in life, no matter how much things change, or where life takes either of us, you'll always be someone really special to me. And I think you already know that. You have your own place in my life that nobody else can just take, and I hope you never doubt that. Even if we have disagreements, even if we get annoyed with each other, even if things aren't always perfect, I'll always care about you and want the best for you. Thank you for all the laughs, all the conversations, all the times you've listened to me yap about my problems, and all the little things you've done that you probably don't even realise mean so much to me. Thank you for being YOU, for staying, for being a part of my life, and for giving me so many reasons to be grateful for our friendship. I might not always express it properly, and I might mess up sometimes, but I really do appreciate you more than you know. I'm sorry for the times I've hurt you, knowingly or unknowingly, and I hope you can forgive me for my mistakes just as I've forgiven yours. I never want you to feel like you're any less important to me because of a bad day or a bad moment. I hope this new year of your life brings you all the happiness you deserve, all the love you give to other people back to you, and so many reasons to smile that you forget what crying even feels like. I hope you achieve everything you dream of, find people who treat you right, and never feel like you have to change who you are to be loved. And please, for the love of God, work on that singing. 😭🙏🏻 Happy Birthday once again, PAAGAL. ❤️🫂 I'm genuinely so, so thankful that you're a part of my life. Whatever happens, I'm here for you. Always. Never forget that, okay? You mean a lot to me, more than I probably manage to put into words, and I'm really lucky to have you. Thank you for everything. ❤️🫶🏻
— Your Thunder Buddy
Jokes aside, I'm genuinely lucky to have you in my life. I hope you always know how loved and appreciated you are. Happy birthday, PAAGAL. 💗
